   159	    by_cases hab : a = b
   160	    · simp [hab]
   161	    · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab]
   162	  · cases hvA : validPauliAnswer tA a
   163	    · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvA]
   164	    · cases hvB : validPauliAnswer tB b
   165	      · simp [pauliWinPredicate, hvB]
   166	      · simp only [pauliWinPredicate, hvA, hvB, Bool.and_self,
   167	          if_neg hT, if_neg (Ne.symm hT)]
   168	        rcases tA with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iA|jA) <;>
   169	          rcases a with uA|fA|gA|bitsA|bitA|trA|hhA <;>
   170	          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvA) <;>
   171	          rcases tB with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iB|jB) <;>
   172	          rcases b with uB|fB|gB|bitsB|bitB|trB|hhB <;>
   173	          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvB) <;>
   174	          rfl
   175	
   176	/-- The symmetric presentation of the Pauli basis test. The field and basis
   177	are those fixed by `P.model`; no additional model is quantified. -/
   178	noncomputable def pauliBasisTestSymm (P : AdmissibleParams) : SymmetricGame where
   179	  Question := PauliQuestion P
   180	  Answer := PauliAnswer P
   181	  μ := pauliQuestionDistribution P
   182	  μ_prob := (pauliBasisTest P).μ_prob
   183	  μ_symm := pauliQuestionDistribution_symm P
   184	  decide := pauliWinPredicate P
   185	  decide_symm := pauliWinPredicate_symm P
   186	
   187	/-- The symmetric presentation has the Pauli basis test as its
   188	underlying game. -/
   189	theorem pauliBasisTestSymm_toGame (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   190	    (pauliBasisTestSymm P).toGame = pauliBasisTest P := by
   191	  rfl
   192	
   193	/-- The honest strategy of `lem:pauli-completeness`: the total honest
   194	measurement family of `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness.HonestStrategy.Assembly`
   195	on the maximally entangled state of the Pauli register tensored with the Magic
   196	Square qubit.  Blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   197	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`. -/
   198	noncomputable def honestStrategy (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   199	    SymmetricStrategy (pauliBasisTestSymm P) where
   200	  ι := HonestIndex P
   201	  ψ := eprState (HonestIndex P)
   202	  ψ_norm := eprState_norm (HonestIndex P)
   203	  ψ_swap := reindexState_prodComm_eprState (HonestIndex P)
   204	  M := fun q => honestMeasurement P q.1 q.2
   205	
   206	/-- Every measurement of the honest strategy is projective. -/
   207	theorem honestStrategy_projective (P : AdmissibleParams) (x : PauliQuestion P) :
   208	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective ((honestStrategy P).M x) :=
   209	  honestMeasurement_projective P x.1 x.2
   210	
   211	/-- The honest strategy is consistent on its maximally entangled state. -/
   212	theorem honestStrategy_isConsistent (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   213	    (honestStrategy P).IsConsistent :=
   214	  fun x => honestMeasurement_isConsistentOn P x.1 x.2
   215	
   216	/-- The honest strategy is a symmetric projective consistent commuting
   217	strategy: every measurement is projective, the family is consistent on the
   218	maximally entangled state, and the effects commute on every question pair of
   219	positive weight. -/
   220	theorem honestStrategy_isSPCC (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   221	    (honestStrategy P).IsSPCC :=
   222	  ⟨honestStrategy_projective P, honestStrategy_isConsistent P,
   223	    honestMeasurement_commuting P⟩
   224	
   225	/-- On every question pair of positive weight for the Pauli question sampler the
   226	honest measurement family assigns the zero operator product to every rejected
   227	answer pair.  This is the operator form of perfect acceptance in
   228	`lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   229	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1383-1421`. -/
   230	theorem honestMeasurement_rejected_mul (P : AdmissibleParams)
   231	    (x y : PauliQuestion P) (hxy : 0 < (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (x, y))
   232	    (a b : PauliAnswer P) (hrej : pauliWinPredicate P x y a b = false) :
   233	    (honestMeasurement P x.1 x.2).effect a *
   234	      (honestMeasurement P y.1 y.2).effect b = 0 := by
   235	  classical
   236	  obtain ⟨z, hedge, hx, hy⟩ := pauliQuestionDistribution_pos_incidence P x y hxy
   237	  obtain ⟨t₁, x₁⟩ := x
   238	  obtain ⟨t₂, x₂⟩ := y
   239	  dsimp only at hx hy hedge ⊢
   240	  subst hx
   241	  subst hy
   242	  rcases pauliEdges_cases hedge with heq | ⟨s₁, s₂, hs₁, hs₂, hms⟩ | hor | hor
   243	  · rw [heq] at hrej ⊢
   244	    rcases (Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true
   245	      (validPauliAnswer (P := P) t₂ a)).symm with hva | hva
   246	    · rw [honestMeasurement_effect_eq_zero_of_invalid P _ _ hva, zero_mul]
   247	    have hab : a ≠ b := by
   248	      rintro rfl
   249	      rw [show pauliWinPredicate P (t₂, pauliCL P t₂ z) (t₂, pauliCL P t₂ z) a a
   250	          = true from by simp [pauliWinPredicate, hva]] at hrej
   251	      exact Bool.noConfusion hrej
   252	    exact DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero _
   253	      (honestMeasurement_projective P t₂ _) hab
   254	  · subst hs₁
   255	    subst hs₂
   256	    exact honest_ms_rejected_mul P z hms a b hrej
   257	  · exact honest_oriented_rejected_mul P hor z a b hrej
   258	  · rw [← (honestMeasurement_commute_of_oriented P hor z b a).eq]
   259	    refine honest_oriented_rejected_mul P hor z b a ?_
   260	    rw [pauliWinPredicate_symm]
   261	    exact hrej
   262	
   263	/-- `lem:pauli-completeness`: every admissible Pauli basis test has a
   264	value-one SPCC strategy. Blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   265	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1229-1421`. -/
   266	theorem exists_spcc_value_one (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   267	    ∃ S : SymmetricStrategy (pauliBasisTestSymm P),
   268	      S.IsSPCC ∧ S.toStrategy.value = 1 := by
   269	  classical
   270	  refine ⟨honestStrategy P, honestStrategy_isSPCC P, ?_⟩
   271	  have hborn : ∀ x y : PauliQuestion P,
   272	      0 < (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (x, y) →
   273	      ∀ a b : PauliAnswer P, pauliWinPredicate P x y a b = false →
   274	        outcomeWeight (honestStrategy P).toStrategy x y a b = 0 := by
   275	    intro x y hxy a b hrej
   276	    have hmul := honestMeasurement_rejected_mul P x y hxy a b hrej
   277	    have hzero := heteroKron_mulVec_epr_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero
   278	      ((honestMeasurement P x.1 x.2).effect a)
   279	      ((honestMeasurement P y.1 y.2).effect b)
   280	      (honestMeasurement_effect_transpose P y.1 y.2 b) hmul
   281	    have hacted : applyOperatorToState
   282	        (heteroKron ((honestMeasurement P x.1 x.2).effect a)
   283	          ((honestMeasurement P y.1 y.2).effect b))
   284	        (eprState (HonestIndex P)) = 0 := by
   285	      rw [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, hzero]
   286	      rfl
   287	    change (inner ℂ (eprState (HonestIndex P))
   288	      (applyOperatorToState
   289	        (heteroKron ((honestMeasurement P x.1 x.2).effect a)
   290	          ((honestMeasurement P y.1 y.2).effect b))
   291	        (eprState (HonestIndex P)))).re = 0
   292	    rw [hacted]
   293	    simp
   294	  have hone : ∀ x y : PauliQuestion P,
   295	      0 < (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (x, y) →
   296	      (∑ a : PauliAnswer P, ∑ b : PauliAnswer P,
   297	        if pauliWinPredicate P x y a b then
   298	          outcomeWeight (honestStrategy P).toStrategy x y a b else 0) = 1 := by
   299	    intro x y hxy
   300	    have hcong : (∑ a : PauliAnswer P, ∑ b : PauliAnswer P,
   301	        if pauliWinPredicate P x y a b then
   302	          outcomeWeight (honestStrategy P).toStrategy x y a b else 0) =
   303	        ∑ a : PauliAnswer P, ∑ b : PauliAnswer P,
   304	          outcomeWeight (honestStrategy P).toStrategy x y a b := by
   305	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   306	      by_cases hab : pauliWinPredicate P x y a b = true
   307	      · simp [hab]
   308	      · have hab' := Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true hab
   309	        rw [hborn x y hxy a b hab']
   310	        simp [hab']
   311	    rw [hcong]
   312	    exact outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one (honestStrategy P).toStrategy x y
   313	  change avgOver (pauliQuestionDistribution P) (fun xy =>
   314	    ∑ a : PauliAnswer P, ∑ b : PauliAnswer P,
   315	      if pauliWinPredicate P xy.1 xy.2 a b then
   316	        outcomeWeight (honestStrategy P).toStrategy xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0) = 1
   317	  have hcongr : avgOver (pauliQuestionDistribution P) (fun xy =>
   318	      ∑ a : PauliAnswer P, ∑ b : PauliAnswer P,
   319	        if pauliWinPredicate P xy.1 xy.2 a b then
   320	          outcomeWeight (honestStrategy P).toStrategy xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0) =
   321	      avgOver (pauliQuestionDistribution P) (fun _ => 1) := by
   322	    simp only [avgOver]
   323	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun xy _ => ?_
   324	    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ((pauliQuestionDistribution P).nonnegative xy) with hpos | hzero
   325	    · rw [hone xy.1 xy.2 hpos]
   326	    · rw [← hzero, zero_mul, zero_mul]
   327	  rw [hcongr]
   328	  exact avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (pauliBasisTestSymm P).μ_prob 1
   329	
   330	end

     3	/-!
     4	# Assembling the honest Pauli strategy
     5	
     6	This module assembles the measurements of
     7	`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness.HonestStrategy` into a single measurement
     8	family indexed by the question type of the Pauli basis test.  Each honest
     9	measurement acts on the tensor product of the Pauli register with the qubit
    10	supplied to the Magic Square construction, and every outcome is relabelled into
    11	the common answer alphabet of the test.  The results recorded here are the
    12	projectivity and the symmetry of every effect of that family.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The strategy assembled here is the one displayed in the proof of
    17	`lem:pauli-completeness`,
    18	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`;
    19	blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    27	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K]
    32	  [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    33	
    34	/-! ### Measurement assembly lemmas -/
    35	
    36	/-- The one-outcome measurement, used to make the harmless branches of the
    37	honest strategy total on questions outside the sampler support. -/
    38	noncomputable def unitMeasurement (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] :
    39	    Measurement Unit V :=
    40	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun _ => 1)
    41	    (fun _ => Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg) (by simp)
    42	
    43	/-- A deterministic measurement with prescribed outcome. -/
    44	noncomputable def deterministicMeasurement {α V : Type*}
    45	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    46	    (a : α) : Measurement α V :=
    47	  (unitMeasurement V).postprocess fun _ => a
    48	
    49	/-- A deterministic measurement is projective. -/
    50	theorem deterministicMeasurement_projective {α V : Type*}
    51	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    52	    (a : α) :
    53	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
    54	      (deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a) := by
    55	  apply SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective
    56	  intro u
    57	  cases u
    58	  exact IsStarProjection.one _
    59	
    60	/-- Every effect of a deterministic measurement is symmetric. -/
    61	theorem deterministicMeasurement_effect_transpose {α V : Type*}
    62	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    63	    (a b : α) :
    64	    ((deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a).effect b)ᵀ =
    65	      (deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a).effect b := by
    66	  apply postprocess_effect_transpose
    67	  intro u
    68	  cases u
    69	  exact Matrix.transpose_one
    70	
    71	/-- A deterministic measurement has zero effect away from its prescribed
    72	outcome. -/
    73	theorem deterministicMeasurement_effect_eq_zero_of_ne {α V : Type*}
    74	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    75	    {a₀ a : α} (ha : a ≠ a₀) :
    76	    (deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a₀).effect a = 0 := by
    77	  rw [show deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a₀ =
    78	      (unitMeasurement V).postprocess (fun _ => a₀) by rfl]
    79	  apply postprocess_effect_eq_zero_of_notMem
    80	  rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    81	  exact ha hu.symm
    82	
    83	/-- Placing a projective measurement on the first tensor factor preserves
    84	projectivity. -/
    85	theorem leftPlacedMeasurement_projective {α V W : Type*}
    86	    [Fintype α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    87	    (M : Measurement α V) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    88	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
    89	      (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := W) M) := by
    90	  intro a
    91	  exact MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.isProj_kronecker
    92	    (hM a) (IsStarProjection.one _)
    93	
    94	/-- Tensor placement on the first factor preserves symmetry of effects. -/
    95	theorem leftPlacedMeasurement_effect_transpose {α V W : Type*}
    96	    [Fintype α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    97	    (M : Measurement α V) (hM : ∀ a, (M.effect a)ᵀ = M.effect a) (a : α) :
    98	    ((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := W) M).effect a)ᵀ =
    99	      (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := W) M).effect a := by
   100	  change (heteroKron (M.effect a) (1 : Op W))ᵀ =
   101	    heteroKron (M.effect a) (1 : Op W)
   102	  ext ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨j, l⟩
   103	  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   104	    Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   105	  rw [show M.effect a j i = M.effect a i j by
   106	    exact congrFun (congrFun (hM a) i) j]
   107	  by_cases hkl : k = l
   108	  · subst l
   109	    simp
   110	  · simp [hkl, Ne.symm hkl]
   111	
   112	/-- Two coarse-grainings of one projective measurement commute. -/
   113	theorem postprocess_effect_commute {ζ α β V : Type*}
   114	    [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   115	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   116	    (M : Measurement ζ V) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
   117	    (f : ζ → α) (g : ζ → β) (a : α) (b : β) :
   118	    Commute ((M.postprocess f).effect a) ((M.postprocess g).effect b) := by
   119	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   120	  refine Commute.sum_left _ _ _ ?_
   121	  intro x _
   122	  refine Commute.sum_right _ _ _ ?_
   123	  intro y _
   124	  by_cases hxy : x = y
   125	  · subst y
   126	    exact Commute.refl _
   127	  · rw [commute_iff_eq,
   128	      DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero M hM hxy,
   129	      DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero M hM (Ne.symm hxy)]
   130	
   131	/-- Incompatible fibers of two coarse-grainings of one projective measurement
   132	have zero product. -/
   133	theorem postprocess_effect_mul_eq_zero_of_incompatible {ζ α β V : Type*}
   134	    [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   135	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   136	    (M : Measurement ζ V) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
   137	    (f : ζ → α) (g : ζ → β) (a : α) (b : β)
   138	    (hbad : ∀ z, f z = a → g z = b → False) :
   139	    (M.postprocess f).effect a * (M.postprocess g).effect b = 0 := by
   140	  classical
   141	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.postprocess_effect,
   142	    Finset.sum_mul]
   143	  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   144	  intro x hx
   145	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   146	  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   147	  intro y hy
   148	  by_cases hxy : x = y
   149	  · subst y
   150	    exact (hbad x (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
   151	      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2).elim
   152	  · exact DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero M hM hxy
   153	
   154	/-- Commutation is preserved when both operators are placed on the first
   155	tensor factor. -/
   156	theorem leftPlaced_commute {V W : Type*}
   157	    [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
   158	    {A B : Op V} (h : Commute A B) :
   159	    Commute (heteroKron A (1 : Op W)) (heteroKron B (1 : Op W)) := by
   160	  rw [commute_iff_eq, heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, h.eq]
   161	
   162	/-- A zero product remains zero after placement on the first tensor factor. -/
   163	theorem leftPlaced_mul_eq_zero {V W : Type*}
   164	    [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
   165	    {A B : Op V} (h : A * B = 0) :
   166	    heteroKron A (1 : Op W) * heteroKron B (1 : Op W) = 0 := by
   167	  rw [heteroKron_mul, h]
   168	  ext ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨j, l⟩
   169	  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   170	
   171	/-- The local Hilbert-space index used by the honest Pauli strategy.  The
   172	second factor is the qubit supplied to the Magic Square construction. -/
   173	abbrev HonestIndex (P : AdmissibleParams) := PauliRegister P × ZMod 2
   174	
   175	/-- Place a Pauli-register measurement on the first factor of the honest local
   176	space and relabel its outcomes with a global answer constructor. -/
   177	noncomputable def placedPauliMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams}
   178	    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   179	    (M : Measurement α (PauliRegister P)) (f : α → PauliAnswer P) :
   180	    Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) :=
   181	  (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f
   182	
   183	/-- Incompatible coarse-grained outcomes of two measurements on the Pauli
   184	register have zero product after tensor placement. -/
   185	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_mul_eq_zero_of_incompatible {P : AdmissibleParams}
   186	    {ζ : Type*} [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ]
   187	    (M : Measurement ζ (PauliRegister P))
   188	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
   189	    (f g : ζ → PauliAnswer P)
   190	    (a b : PauliAnswer P)
   191	    (hbad : ∀ h, f h = a → g h = b → False) :
   192	    (placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a *
   193	        (placedPauliMeasurement M g).effect b = 0 := by
   194	  change ((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect a *
   195	      ((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess g).effect b = 0
   196	  exact postprocess_effect_mul_eq_zero_of_incompatible
   197	    (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M)
   198	    (leftPlacedMeasurement_projective M hM) f g a b hbad
   199	
   200	/-- Coarse-grainings of one Pauli basis measurement commute after tensor
   201	placement. -/
   202	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_commute {P : AdmissibleParams}
   203	    {ζ : Type*} [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ]
   204	    (M : Measurement ζ (PauliRegister P))
   205	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
   206	    (f g : ζ → PauliAnswer P)
   207	    (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   208	    Commute ((placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a)
   209	      ((placedPauliMeasurement M g).effect b) := by
   210	  change Commute
   211	    (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect a)
   212	    (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess g).effect b)
   213	  exact postprocess_effect_commute
   214	    (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M)
   215	    (leftPlacedMeasurement_projective M hM) f g a b
   216	
   217	/-- An answer outside a placed coarse-graining's relabelling range has zero
   218	effect. -/
   219	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_effect_eq_zero_of_notMem {P : AdmissibleParams}
   220	    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   221	    (M : Measurement α (PauliRegister P)) (f : α → PauliAnswer P)
   222	    {a : PauliAnswer P} (ha : a ∉ Set.range f) :
   223	    (placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a = 0 := by
   224	  change ((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect a = 0
   225	  exact postprocess_effect_eq_zero_of_notMem _ _ ha

   227	/-! ### The total honest measurement family -/
   228	
   229	/-- Embed a Magic Square answer into the global Pauli-test answer alphabet. -/
   230	def pauliAnswerOfMs {P : AdmissibleParams} : MsAnswer → PauliAnswer P
   231	  | .triple a => .msTriple a
   232	  | .bit a => .bit a
   233	
   234	/-- The embedding of Magic Square answers is injective. -/
   235	theorem pauliAnswerOfMs_injective {P : AdmissibleParams} :
   236	    Function.Injective (@pauliAnswerOfMs P) := by
   237	  intro a b h
   238	  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp only [pauliAnswerOfMs] at h <;> cases h <;> rfl
   239	
   240	/-- The honest point measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/
   241	noncomputable def honestPointMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   242	    (z : PauliSpace P) : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) :=
   243	  placedPauliMeasurement (pauliPointMeasurement P W (pauliPointBlock W z))
   244	    (fun a => .value a)

   247	noncomputable def honestALineMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   248	    (z : PauliSpace P) : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) :=
   249	  placedPauliMeasurement (pauliALineMeasurement P W z) (fun a => .alinePoly a)

   252	noncomputable def honestDLineMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   253	    (z : PauliSpace P) : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) :=

   256	/-- The honest Pauli/W measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/
   257	noncomputable def honestPauliMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind) :

   261	/-- The honest Pair/W measurement at a typed Pauli question. The trace
   262	measurement is retained when the phase is nonzero, whereas the proof of
   263	`lem:pauli-completeness` chooses a trivial measurement in that inactive case.
   264	The corresponding Pair checks then accept automatically. The present choice
   265	remains projective, consistent, and commuting along the question graph, so it
   266	gives the same existential completeness conclusion. -/
   267	noncomputable def honestPairWMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   268	    (z : PauliSpace P) : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) :=
   269	  placedPauliMeasurement
   270	    (pauliTraceMeasurement P W
   271	      (pauliPointBlock W z)
   272	      (match W with | .X => pauliRXBlock z | .Z => pauliRZBlock z))
   273	    (fun a => .bit a)

   275	/-- The honest Pair measurement, with a deterministic harmless branch when the
   276	two Pair/W observables anticommute. -/
   277	noncomputable def honestPairMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   278	    (z : PauliSpace P) : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) := by
   279	  classical
   280	  by_cases hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0
   281	  · exact placedPauliMeasurement (pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma)
   282	      (fun a => .pairBits a)
   283	  · exact deterministicMeasurement (V := HonestIndex P) (.pairBits (0, 0))

   285	/-- The honest Magic Square measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/

   287	    (z : PauliSpace P) : Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) := by
   288	  classical
   289	  by_cases hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0
   290	  · exact deterministicMeasurement (V := HonestIndex P)
   291	      (match t with
   292	      | .constraint _ => (.msTriple 0 : PauliAnswer P)
   293	      | .var _ => (.bit 0 : PauliAnswer P))
   294	  · exact (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma t).postprocess pauliAnswerOfMs

   296	/-- The total honest measurement family, defined on all 26 Pauli question
   297	types and all ambient coefficient vectors. -/

   299	    (t : PauliType) (z : PauliSpace P) :
   300	    Measurement (PauliAnswer P) (HonestIndex P) :=

   303	  | .aline W => honestALineMeasurement P W z
   304	  | .dline W => honestDLineMeasurement P W z

   306	  | .pairW W => honestPairWMeasurement P W z

   310	/-- Injective answer relabelling preserves projectivity of a placed Pauli
   311	measurement. -/
   312	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_projective {P : AdmissibleParams}
   313	    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   314	    (M : Measurement α (PauliRegister P))
   315	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
   316	    (f : α → PauliAnswer P) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   317	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (placedPauliMeasurement M f) := by
   318	  intro a
   319	  by_cases ha : a ∈ Set.range f
   320	  · rcases ha with ⟨b, rfl⟩
   321	    change IsProj (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect
   322	      (f b))
   323	    rw [SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective _ f hf b]
   324	    exact MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.isProj_kronecker
   325	      (hM b) (IsStarProjection.one _)
   326	  · change IsProj
   327	      (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect a)
   328	    rw [postprocess_effect_eq_zero_of_notMem _ _ ha]
   329	    exact IsStarProjection.zero _

   332	measurement. -/
   333	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose {P : AdmissibleParams}
   334	    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   335	    (M : Measurement α (PauliRegister P))
   336	    (hM : ∀ a, (M.effect a)ᵀ = M.effect a)
   337	    (f : α → PauliAnswer P) (a : PauliAnswer P) :
   338	    ((placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a)ᵀ =
   339	      (placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a := by
   340	  rw [show placedPauliMeasurement M f =
   341	      (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f by rfl]
   342	  apply postprocess_effect_transpose
   343	  intro b
   344	  exact leftPlacedMeasurement_effect_transpose M hM b

   346	/-- The global honest measurement is projective at every question. -/
   347	theorem honestMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams) (t : PauliType)
   348	    (z : PauliSpace P) :
   349	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (honestMeasurement P t z) := by
   350	  cases t with
   351	  | point W =>
   352	      simpa [honestMeasurement, honestPointMeasurement] using
   353	        (placedPauliMeasurement_projective
   354	          (pauliPointMeasurement P W (pauliPointBlock W z))
   355	          (pauliPointMeasurement_projective P W (pauliPointBlock W z))
   356	          (fun a => PauliAnswer.value a) (by intro; simp))
   357	  | aline W =>
   358	      simpa [honestMeasurement, honestALineMeasurement] using
   359	        (placedPauliMeasurement_projective (pauliALineMeasurement P W z)
   360	          (pauliALineMeasurement_projective P W z)
   361	          (fun a => PauliAnswer.alinePoly a) (by intro; simp))
   362	  | dline W =>
   363	      simpa [honestMeasurement, honestDLineMeasurement] using
   364	        (placedPauliMeasurement_projective (pauliDLineMeasurement P W z)
   365	          (pauliDLineMeasurement_projective P W z)
   366	          (fun a => PauliAnswer.dlinePoly a) (by intro; simp))
   367	  | pauli W =>
   368	      simpa [honestMeasurement, honestPauliMeasurement] using
   369	        (placedPauliMeasurement_projective (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   370	          (fun a => pauliProj_isProj W a)
   371	          (fun a => PauliAnswer.pauliOutcome a) (by intro; simp))
   372	  | pairW W =>
   373	      simpa [honestMeasurement, honestPairWMeasurement] using
   374	        (placedPauliMeasurement_projective
   375	          (pauliTraceMeasurement P W (pauliPointBlock W z)
   376	            (match W with | .X => pauliRXBlock z | .Z => pauliRZBlock z))
   377	          (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P W _ _)
   378	          (fun a => PauliAnswer.bit a) (by intro; simp))
   379	  | pair =>
   380	      classical
   381	      by_cases hg : pauliPairGamma P z = 0
   382	      · simpa [honestMeasurement, honestPairMeasurement, hg] using
   383	          (placedPauliMeasurement_projective (pauliPairMeasurement P z hg)
   384	            (pauliPairMeasurement_projective P z hg)
   385	            (fun a => PauliAnswer.pairBits a) (by intro; simp))
   386	      · simpa [honestMeasurement, honestPairMeasurement, hg] using
   387	          (deterministicMeasurement_projective
   388	            (V := HonestIndex P) (α := PauliAnswer P) (.pairBits (0, 0)))
   389	  | ms t =>

   391	      by_cases hg : pauliPairGamma P z = 0
   392	      · simpa [honestMeasurement, honestMagicMeasurement, hg] using

   395	            (match t with
   396	            | .constraint _ => (.msTriple 0 : PauliAnswer P)
   397	            | .var _ => (.bit 0 : PauliAnswer P)))
   398	      · simpa [honestMeasurement, honestMagicMeasurement, hg] using
   399	          (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hg t)
   400	            (pauliMagicMeasurement_projective P z hg t) pauliAnswerOfMs)

   430	/-- The global honest measurement has symmetric effects. -/
   431	theorem honestMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : AdmissibleParams) (t : PauliType)
   432	    (z : PauliSpace P) (a : PauliAnswer P) :
   433	    ((honestMeasurement P t z).effect a)ᵀ =
   434	      (honestMeasurement P t z).effect a := by

   437	      change ((honestPointMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
   438	        (honestPointMeasurement P W z).effect a

   440	        (pauliPointMeasurement_effect_transpose P W (pauliPointBlock W z)) _ _
   441	  | aline W =>
   442	      change ((honestALineMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
   443	        (honestALineMeasurement P W z).effect a
   444	      exact placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose _
   445	        (pauliALineMeasurement_effect_transpose P W z) _ _
   446	  | dline W =>
   447	      change ((honestDLineMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
   448	        (honestDLineMeasurement P W z).effect a
   449	      exact placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose _
   450	        (pauliDLineMeasurement_effect_transpose P W z) _ _
   451	  | pauli W =>
   452	      change ((honestPauliMeasurement P W).effect a)ᵀ =
   453	        (honestPauliMeasurement P W).effect a
   454	      exact placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose _
   455	        (pauliBasisMeasurement_effect_transpose W) _ _

   458	        (honestPairWMeasurement P W z).effect a

   460	        (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose P W _ _) _ _
   461	  | pair =>
   462	      classical
   463	      by_cases hg : pauliPairGamma P z = 0
   464	      · simpa [honestMeasurement, honestPairMeasurement, hg] using
   465	          (placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose (pauliPairMeasurement P z hg)
   466	            (fun β => by
   467	              change (pauliPairEffect P z β)ᵀ = pauliPairEffect P z β
   468	              rw [pauliPairEffect, Matrix.transpose_mul,
   469	                pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose,
   470	                pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose]

   484	            | .var _ => (.bit 0 : PauliAnswer P)) a)

   486	          (postprocess_effect_transpose (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hg t)
   487	            pauliAnswerOfMs
   488	            (fun b => pauliMagicMeasurement_effect_transpose P z hg t b) a)

   492	theorem honestMeasurement_isConsistentOn (P : AdmissibleParams) (t : PauliType)
   493	    (z : PauliSpace P) :
   494	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsConsistentOn (honestMeasurement P t z)

   498	/-- Two coarse-grainings of one projective measurement of the Pauli register
   499	still have commuting effects after tensor placement and answer relabelling.
   500	This is the commutation of the honest measurements sharing a Pauli basis in the
   501	proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   502	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1372`. -/
   503	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_postprocess_commute {P : AdmissibleParams}
   504	    {ζ α β : Type*} [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   505	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   506	    (M : Measurement ζ (PauliRegister P))
   507	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
   508	    (g₁ : ζ → α) (g₂ : ζ → β)
   509	    (u : α → PauliAnswer P) (v : β → PauliAnswer P) (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   510	    Commute ((placedPauliMeasurement (M.postprocess g₁) u).effect a)
   511	      ((placedPauliMeasurement (M.postprocess g₂) v).effect b) := by
   512	  classical
   513	  change Commute
   514	    (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2)
   515	        (M.postprocess g₁)).postprocess u).effect a)
   516	    (((DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2)
   517	        (M.postprocess g₂)).postprocess v).effect b)
   518	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   519	  refine Commute.sum_left _ _ _ fun x _ => Commute.sum_right _ _ _ fun y _ => ?_
   520	  change Commute (heteroKron ((M.postprocess g₁).effect x) (1 : Op (ZMod 2)))
   521	    (heteroKron ((M.postprocess g₂).effect y) (1 : Op (ZMod 2)))
   522	  exact leftPlaced_commute (postprocess_effect_commute M hM g₁ g₂ x y)
   523	
   524	/-- The effects of one honest measurement commute with one another; this is the
   525	commutation along the self-loops of the Pauli question graph in
   526	`lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   527	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1372`. -/
   528	theorem honestMeasurement_self_commute (P : AdmissibleParams) (t : PauliType)
   529	    (z : PauliSpace P) (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   530	    Commute ((honestMeasurement P t z).effect a)
   531	      ((honestMeasurement P t z).effect b) := by
   532	  by_cases hab : a = b
   533	  · subst hab
   534	    exact Commute.refl _
   535	  · rw [commute_iff_eq,
   536	      DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero _
   537	        (honestMeasurement_projective P t z) hab,
   538	      DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero _
   539	        (honestMeasurement_projective P t z) (Ne.symm hab)]

     8	/-!
     9	# The honest Pauli basis measurements of the completeness proof
    10	
    11	This module builds the measurements used by the honest strategy of
    12	`lem:pauli-completeness`: the generalized Pauli basis measurement in a fixed
    13	basis `W`, and its coarse-graining by the binary trace
    14	`h ↦ tr(g_h(u_W) r_W)` which the source calls `A` (for `W = X`) and `B`
    15	(for `W = Z`).  The main results are the observable identity
    16	
    17	  `A_0 - A_1 = τ^W(ind_m(u_W) r_W)`
    18	
    19	of `eq:finally-got-an-observable`, and the resulting commutation law
    20	
    21	  `𝒪_A 𝒪_B = (-1)^γ 𝒪_B 𝒪_A`
    22	
    23	with `γ` the phase bit `eq:gamma-value`.  When `γ ≠ 0` the two observables
    24	anticommute, so `thm:ms-from-ac` produces the Magic Square part of the honest
    25	strategy.
    26	
    27	## References
    28	
    29	The construction is the strategy displayed in the proof of
    30	`lem:pauli-completeness`,
    31	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`;
    32	blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`.
    33	-/

    47	/-! ### The generalized Pauli basis measurement -/
    48	
    49	/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a nonnegative operator.  The
    50	positive semidefiniteness it repackages is `posSemidef_pauliProj`, blueprint
    51	`def:generalized-pauli`, paper origin
    52	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
    53	theorem pauliProj_nonneg (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : 0 ≤ pauliProj W e :=
    54	  Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (posSemidef_pauliProj W e)
    55	
    56	/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is Hermitian. -/
    57	theorem pauliProj_conjTranspose (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    58	    (pauliProj W e)ᴴ = pauliProj W e :=
    59	  (posSemidef_pauliProj W e).isHermitian.eq
    60	
    61	/-- The generalized Pauli basis measurement in basis `W`: the projective
    62	measurement whose outcomes are the labels of blueprint `def:generalized-pauli`, paper origin
    63	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
    64	noncomputable def pauliBasisMeasurement (W : PauliKind) :
    65	    Measurement (ι → K) (ι → K) :=
    66	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliProj W) (pauliProj_nonneg W) (sum_pauliProj_eq_one W)
    67	
    68	@[simp] theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_effect (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    69	    (pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect e = pauliProj W e := rfl

    71	/-! ### Symmetry and Hermiticity of the generalized Pauli observables -/
    72	
    73	omit [Fintype K] in
    74	/-- Generalized Pauli observables are symmetric matrices in the computational
    75	basis.  Symmetry is what makes the honest measurements consistent on the EPR
    76	state used by `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
    77	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1360`. -/
    78	theorem tauObservable_transpose (W : PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
    79	    (tauObservable W a)ᵀ = tauObservable W a := by
    80	  haveI : CharP K 2 := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
    81	  have hswap : ∀ x y c : K, (x = y + c) ↔ (y = x + c) := by
    82	    intro x y c
    83	    constructor
    84	    · rintro rfl
    85	      rw [add_assoc, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, add_zero]
    86	    · rintro rfl
    87	      rw [add_assoc, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, add_zero]
    88	  ext x y
    89	  rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
    90	  cases W with
    91	  | X =>
    92	      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    93	      change (if y i = x i + a i then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = if x i = y i + a i then 1 else 0
    94	      by_cases h : x i = y i + a i
    95	      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((hswap _ _ _).mp h)]
    96	      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h ((hswap _ _ _).mp hc))]
    97	  | Z =>
    98	      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    99	      change (if y i = x i then phaseSign (binTrace K (a i * x i)) else 0) =
   100	        if x i = y i then phaseSign (binTrace K (a i * y i)) else 0
   101	      by_cases h : x i = y i
   102	      · rw [h]
   103	      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h hc.symm)]

   105	/-! ### Orthogonality of the generalized Pauli projectors
   106	
   107	The generalized Pauli projectors in a fixed basis are pairwise orthogonal, so
   108	every coarse-graining of a Pauli basis measurement is again projective.  This is
   109	the projectivity used throughout the honest strategy of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
   110	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`.
   111	-/
   112	
   113	
   114	/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a projector. -/
   115	theorem pauliProj_isProj (W : PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : IsProj (pauliProj W e) := by
   116	  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   117	  · simpa using pauliProj_mul_pauliProj W e e
   118	  · rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, pauliProj_conjTranspose]
   119

   146	/-! ### The honest Pair/W measurements

   148	For an ambient question `ω = (u_X, u_Z, r_X, r_Z)` the honest player measures

   150	`tr(g_h(u_W) r_W)` of the resulting label.  These are the measurements `A` and
   151	`B` of the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
   152	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1330`.

   154

   157	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1330`. -/
   158	noncomputable def pauliTraceBit (P : AdmissibleParams)

   162	/-- The honest Pair/W measurement `τ^W_{[tr(g_·(u) r) = β]}` of the proof of

   165	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1290-1330`,
   166	blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
   167	noncomputable def pauliTraceMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   168	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (r : PauliScalar P) :
   169	    Measurement (ZMod 2) (PauliRegister P) :=
   170	  (pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess (pauliTraceBit P u r)

   172	theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   173	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (r : PauliScalar P) (b : ZMod 2) :
   174	    (pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect b =
   175	      ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r h = b),
   176	        pauliProj W h := rfl

   178	/-- Equation `eq:finally-got-an-observable`: the observable of the honest
   179	Pair/W measurement is the generalized Pauli observable at the label
   180	`ind_m(u) r`.  Paper
   181	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1300-1315`. -/
   182	theorem obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   183	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (r : PauliScalar P) :
   184	    obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r) =
   185	      tauObservable W (r • indicatorVec u) := by
   186	  classical
   187	  have hdot : ∀ e : PauliRegister P,
   188	      dotProduct (r • indicatorVec u) e = lowDegreeEnc e u * r := by
   189	    intro e
   190	    rw [lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct]
   191	    simp only [dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
   192	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
   193	  have hp : ∀ e : PauliRegister P,
   194	      phaseSign (binTrace (PauliScalar P) (dotProduct (r • indicatorVec u) e)) =
   195	        phaseSign (pauliTraceBit P u r e) := by
   196	    intro e
   197	    rw [hdot e]
   198	    rfl
   199	  rw [tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj,
   200	    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e (_ : e ∈ Finset.univ) => by rw [hp e]),
   201	    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Finset.univ : Finset (PauliRegister P))
   202	      (fun e => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0)]
   203	  have hfilter :
   204	      (Finset.univ.filter fun e : PauliRegister P => ¬ pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0) =
   205	        Finset.univ.filter fun e : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1 := by
   206	    ext e
   207	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   208	    rcases zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one (pauliTraceBit P u r e) with h | h <;> simp [h]
   209	  have h0 : ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0),
   210	      phaseSign (pauliTraceBit P u r e) • pauliProj W e =
   211	      (pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect 0 := by
   212	    rw [pauliTraceMeasurement_effect]
   213	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_
   214	    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2]
   215	    simp [phaseSign]
   216	  have h1 : ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : PauliRegister P => ¬ pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0),
   217	      phaseSign (pauliTraceBit P u r e) • pauliProj W e =
   218	      -(pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect 1 := by
   219	    rw [hfilter, pauliTraceMeasurement_effect]
   220	    calc ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1),
   221	          phaseSign (pauliTraceBit P u r e) • pauliProj W e
   222	        = ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1),
   223	            (-1 : ℂ) • pauliProj W e :=
   224	          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => by
   225	            rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2]
   226	            norm_num [phaseSign]
   227	      _ = (-1 : ℂ) • ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   228	            (fun e : PauliRegister P => pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1), pauliProj W e :=
   229	          Finset.smul_sum.symm
   230	      _ = _ := neg_one_smul ℂ _
   231	  rw [h0, h1, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
   232	  rfl

   481	    (obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_anticommute P z hgamma) j

   483	/-- Cell effects belonging to one Magic Square constraint commute. -/
   484	theorem pauliMagicCellMeasurement_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
   485	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0)
   486	    (i : Fin 6) (k l : Fin 3) (a b : ZMod 2) :
   487	    Commute
   488	      ((pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hgamma (msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
   489	      ((pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hgamma (msConstraintVars i l)).effect b) := by
   490	  simp only [pauliMagicCellMeasurement]
   491	  exact reflectionEffect_commute
   492	    (msConstraintObservable_commute _ _
   493	      (obsOf_sq _ (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _))
   494	      (obsOf_sq _ (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _))
   495	      (obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_anticommute P z hgamma) i k l) a b
   496	
   497	/-- The Magic Square measurement family used at a Pauli question with nonzero
   498	phase bit. -/
   499	noncomputable def pauliMagicMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   500	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) :
   501	    MsType → Measurement MsAnswer (PauliRegister P × ZMod 2) :=
   502	  msStrategyMeasurement (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hgamma)
   503	    (pauliMagicCellMeasurement_projective P z hgamma)
   504	    (pauliMagicCellMeasurement_commute P z hgamma)
   505	
   506	/-- The Pauli-induced Magic Square measurement is projective. -/
   507	theorem pauliMagicMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   508	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) (x : MsType) :
   509	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
   510	      (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma x) := by
   511	  exact msStrategyMeasurement_projective _ _ _ x
   512	
   513	/-- Every effect of the Pauli-induced Magic Square measurement is symmetric. -/
   514	theorem pauliMagicMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : AdmissibleParams)
   515	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0)
   516	    (x : MsType) (a : MsAnswer) :
   517	    ((pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma x).effect a)ᵀ =
   518	      (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma x).effect a := by
   519	  apply msStrategyMeasurement_effect_transpose
   520	  intro j b
   521	  simp only [pauliMagicCellMeasurement]
   522	  apply msCellMeasurement_transpose
   523	  · rw [obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement]
   524	    exact tauObservable_transpose _ _
   525	  · rw [obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement]
   526	    exact tauObservable_transpose _ _
   527	
   528	/-- The Pauli-induced Magic Square measurements commute on an incident
   529	constraint-variable pair. -/
   530	theorem pauliMagicMeasurement_incident_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
   531	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0)
   532	    (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) (a b : MsAnswer) :
   533	    Commute ((pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma (.constraint i)).effect a)
   534	      ((pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma
   535	        (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).effect b) := by
   536	  exact msStrategyMeasurement_incident_commute _ _ _ i k a b
   537	
   538	/-- The distinguished variable effects of the Pauli-induced Magic Square
   539	measurement are the tensor placements of the Pair/X and Pair/Z effects. -/
   540	theorem pauliMagicMeasurement_var_effect (P : AdmissibleParams)
   541	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) (b : ZMod 2) :
   542	    (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma (.var 0)).effect (.bit b) =
   543	        heteroKron
   544	          ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect b)
   545	          (1 : Op (ZMod 2)) ∧
   546	      (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma (.var 4)).effect (.bit b) =
   547	        heteroKron
   548	          ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b)
   549	          (1 : Op (ZMod 2)) := by
   550	  constructor
   551	  · unfold pauliMagicMeasurement
   552	    rw [msStrategyMeasurement_var_bit]
   553	    change reflectionEffect
   554	        (heteroKron
   555	          (obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)))
   556	          (1 : Op (ZMod 2))) b = _
   557	    rw [← MagicSquareRigidity.reflectionEffect_heteroKron_left,
   558	      reflectionEffect_obsOf_measurement]
   559	  · unfold pauliMagicMeasurement
   560	    rw [msStrategyMeasurement_var_bit]
   561	    change reflectionEffect
   562	        (heteroKron
   563	          (obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)))
   564	          (1 : Op (ZMod 2))) b = _
   565	    rw [← MagicSquareRigidity.reflectionEffect_heteroKron_left,
   566	      reflectionEffect_obsOf_measurement]
   567	
   568	/-! ### The Pair measurement in the case `γ = 0`
   569	
   570	If the phase bit vanishes, the two honest Pair/W measurements commute and their
   571	product is the Pair measurement `E^{Pair,ω}_{β_X, β_Z} = A_{β_X} B_{β_Z}` of
   572	Equation `eq:pair-definition` in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   573	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`.
   574	-/
   575	
   576	/-- If the phase bit `γ` of `eq:gamma-value` vanishes, the two honest Pair/W
   577	observables commute.  Paper
   578	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1316-1330`. -/
   579	theorem obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
   580	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
   581	    Commute (obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)))
   582	      (obsOf (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z))) := by
   583	  rw [commute_iff_eq, obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_mul_comm, hgamma]
   584	  simp [phaseSign]
   585	
   586	/-- If the phase bit `γ` vanishes, the effects of the two honest Pair/W
   587	measurements commute; this is the commutation assertion of the honest strategy
   588	in the case `γ = 0`, paper
   589	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1374-1382`. -/
   590	theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
   591	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (a b : ZMod 2) :
   592	    Commute ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a)
   593	      ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b) := by
   594	  have hOO :
   595	      Commute (tauObservable PauliKind.X (pauliRXBlock z • indicatorVec (pauliXBlock z)))
   596	        (tauObservable PauliKind.Z (pauliRZBlock z • indicatorVec (pauliZBlock z))) := by
   597	    rw [← obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z),
   598	      ← obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)]
   599	    exact obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_commute P z hgamma
   600	  rw [pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect,
   601	    pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect]
   602	  exact reflectionEffect_commute hOO a b
   603	
   604	/-- The Pair effect `E^{Pair,ω}_{β_X, β_Z} = A_{β_X} B_{β_Z}` of Equation
   605	`eq:pair-definition`, paper
   606	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1339`. -/
   607	noncomputable def pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   608	    (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
   609	  (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect β.1 *
   610	    (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect β.2
   611	
   612	/-- For `γ = 0` the Pair effects are projectors, being products of commuting
   613	projectors.  Paper
   614	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`. -/
   615	theorem pauliPairEffect_isProj (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   616	    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) :
   617	    IsProj (pauliPairEffect P z β) :=
   618	  IsStarProjection.mul (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _ β.1)
   619	    (pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _ β.2)
   620	    (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hgamma β.1 β.2)
   621	
   622	/-- The Pair effects sum to the identity. -/
   623	theorem sum_pauliPairEffect (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P) :
   624	    ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β = 1 := by
   625	  calc ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, pauliPairEffect P z β
   626	      = ∑ a : ZMod 2, ∑ b : ZMod 2,
   627	          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
   628	            (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
   629	        Fintype.sum_prod_type _
   630	    _ = ∑ a : ZMod 2,
   631	          (pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
   632	            ∑ b : ZMod 2,
   633	              (pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
   634	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   635	    _ = 1 := by
   636	        rw [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).sum_eq_one]
   637	        simp [(pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).sum_eq_one]
   638	
   639	/-- The Pair measurement of Equation `eq:pair-definition` in the case `γ = 0`,
   640	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`,
   641	blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
   642	noncomputable def pauliPairMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   643	    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) : Measurement (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) (PauliRegister P) :=
   644	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliPairEffect P z)
   645	    (fun β => (pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma β).nonneg) (sum_pauliPairEffect P z)
   646	
   647	/-- The Pair measurement is projective. -/
   648	theorem pauliPairMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   649	    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
   650	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma) :=
   651	  pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma
   652	
   653	/-- The Pair measurement is consistent on the EPR state.  This is the
   654	consistency assertion for the Pair measurement in the case `γ = 0`, paper
   655	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1368-1372`. -/
   656	theorem pauliPairMeasurement_isConsistentOn (P : AdmissibleParams) (z : PauliSpace P)
   657	    (hgamma : pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
   658	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsConsistentOn (pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma)
   659	      (eprState (PauliRegister P)) := by
   660	  intro β
   661	  refine epr_action_eq_of_transpose _ ?_
   662	  change (pauliPairEffect P z β)ᵀ = pauliPairEffect P z β
   663	  rw [pauliPairEffect, Matrix.transpose_mul, pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose,
   664	    pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose]
   665	  exact (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hgamma β.1 β.2).eq.symm
   666	
   667	end
   668	
   669	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     3	/-!
     4	# Commutation of the honest Pauli measurements
     5	
     6	This module proves that the honest measurement family of
     7	`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness.HonestStrategy.Assembly` has commuting effects
     8	on every question pair of positive weight for the Pauli question sampler.  The
     9	argument first characterises the supported question pairs as the typed
    10	conditionally linear images of a single ambient coefficient vector along an edge
    11	of the Pauli type graph, and then treats the five edge families of that graph.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	This is the commutation obligation in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
    16	blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
    17	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1382`.
    18	-/

    33	/-- The ordered incidence forms of the Pauli type graph: an ordered pair of
    34	distinct types listed in `def:pauli-question-distribution` outside the Magic
    35	Square block. Blueprint `def:pauli-question-distribution`. -/
    36	def PauliEdgeOriented (t₁ t₂ : PauliType) : Prop :=
    37	  (∃ W : PauliKind, t₁ = .point W ∧
    38	      (t₂ = .aline W ∨ t₂ = .dline W ∨ t₂ = .pauli W ∨ t₂ = .pairW W)) ∨
    39	    (∃ W : PauliKind, t₁ = .pairW W ∧ t₂ = .pair) ∨
    40	    (t₁ = .point .X ∧ t₂ = .ms (.var 0)) ∨
    41	    (t₁ = .point .Z ∧ t₂ = .ms (.var 4))
    42	
    43	/-- Every edge of the Pauli type graph is a self-loop, an edge of the Magic
    44	Square graph, or one of the listed incidence forms in one of the two
    45	orders. -/
    46	theorem pauliEdges_cases {t₁ t₂ : PauliType} (h : Sym2.mk t₁ t₂ ∈ pauliEdges) :
    47	    t₁ = t₂ ∨
    48	      (∃ s₁ s₂ : MsType, t₁ = .ms s₁ ∧ t₂ = .ms s₂ ∧ Sym2.mk s₁ s₂ ∈ msEdges) ∨
    49	      PauliEdgeOriented t₁ t₂ ∨ PauliEdgeOriented t₂ t₁ := by
    50	  classical
    51	  simp only [pauliEdges, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter,
    52	    Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
    53	    Prod.exists] at h
    54	  rcases h with (((hl | ((ha | hb) | hc)) | (hd | he | he)) | hp) | hm
    55	  · obtain ⟨a, hEq⟩ := hl
    56	    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hEq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;> exact Or.inl rfl
    57	  · obtain ⟨W, hEq⟩ := ha
    58	    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hEq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    59	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨W, rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩)))
    60	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨W, rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩)))
    61	  · obtain ⟨W, hEq⟩ := hb
    62	    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hEq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    63	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨W, rfl, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩)))
    64	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨W, rfl, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩)))
    65	  · obtain ⟨W, hEq⟩ := hc
    66	    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hEq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

    68	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨W, rfl, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))⟩)))
    69	  · obtain ⟨W, hEq⟩ := hd
    70	    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hEq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

    88	/-- Every question pair of positive weight in the Pauli question distribution
    89	consists of the typed conditionally linear images of a single ambient
    90	coefficient vector along an edge of the Pauli type graph. -/
    91	theorem pauliQuestionDistribution_pos_incidence (P : AdmissibleParams)
    92	    (x y : PauliQuestion P) (hxy : 0 < (pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (x, y)) :
    93	    ∃ z : PauliSpace P, Sym2.mk x.1 y.1 ∈ pauliEdges ∧
    94	      x.2 = pauliCL P x.1 z ∧ y.2 = pauliCL P y.1 z := by
    95	  classical
    96	  letI : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
    97	  set F : PauliEdge × PauliSpace P → PauliQuestion P × PauliQuestion P :=
    98	    fun q => ((q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2),
    99	      (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2)) with hF
   100	  have hEq : pauliQuestionDistribution P =
   101	      (uniformDistribution (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).map F := rfl
   102	  rw [hEq] at hxy
   103	  have hmem : (x, y) ∈
   104	      ((uniformDistribution (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).map F).support := by
   105	    by_contra hnot
   106	    rw [((uniformDistribution (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P)).map F).outsideSupport _ hnot]
   107	      at hxy
   108	    exact lt_irrefl 0 hxy
   109	  rw [Distribution.map_support, uniformDistribution_support] at hmem
   110	  obtain ⟨q, -, hq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
   111	  have hx : x = (q.1.val.1, pauliCL P q.1.val.1 q.2) := (congrArg Prod.fst hq).symm
   112	  have hy : y = (q.1.val.2, pauliCL P q.1.val.2 q.2) := (congrArg Prod.snd hq).symm
   113	  subst hx
   114	  subst hy
   115	  exact ⟨q.2, q.1.2, rfl, rfl⟩
   116	
   117	/-! ### Coarse-graining and tensor placement -/
   118	
   119	/-- Pairwise commuting effects stay commuting under coarse-graining. -/
   120	theorem postprocess_commute_of_commute {α β γ δ V : Type*}
   121	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   122	    [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype δ] [DecidableEq δ]
   123	    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   124	    (M : Measurement α V) (N : Measurement β V)
   125	    (h : ∀ x y, Commute (M.effect x) (N.effect y))
   126	    (f : α → γ) (g : β → δ) (a : γ) (b : δ) :
   127	    Commute ((M.postprocess f).effect a) ((N.postprocess g).effect b) := by
   128	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   129	  exact Commute.sum_left _ _ _ fun x _ => Commute.sum_right _ _ _ fun y _ => h x y
   130	
   131	/-- The effect of a placed and relabelled measurement of the Pauli register. -/
   132	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_effect_eq {P : AdmissibleParams}
   133	    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   134	    (M : Measurement α (PauliRegister P)) (f : α → PauliAnswer P)
   135	    (a : PauliAnswer P) :
   136	    (placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a =
   137	      heteroKron ((M.postprocess f).effect a) (1 : Op (ZMod 2)) := by
   138	  rw [placedPauliMeasurement, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   139	  change (∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => f b = a),
   140	      leftTensor (ι₂ := ZMod 2) (M.effect b)) =
   141	    leftTensor (ι₂ := ZMod 2)
   142	      (∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => f b = a), M.effect b)
   143	  exact leftTensor_finset_sum _ _
   144	
   145	/-- Placing a coarse-grained measurement of the Pauli register and relabelling
   146	its outcomes is the placement of the original measurement relabelled along the
   147	composite; this is the fibre-collapse identity for iterated coarse-graining. -/
   148	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_postprocess_eq {P : AdmissibleParams}
   149	    {ζ α : Type*} [Fintype ζ] [DecidableEq ζ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   150	    (M : Measurement ζ (PauliRegister P)) (g : ζ → α) (u : α → PauliAnswer P) :
   151	    placedPauliMeasurement (M.postprocess g) u =
   152	      placedPauliMeasurement M (fun h => u (g h)) := by
   153	  have hplace :
   154	      DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) (M.postprocess g) =
   155	        (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess g := by
   156	    refine Measurement.ext fun b => ?_
   157	    change heteroKron ((M.postprocess g).effect b) (1 : Op (ZMod 2)) = _
   158	    rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   159	    change leftTensor (ι₂ := ZMod 2)
   160	        (∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => g a = b), M.effect a) =
   161	      ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => g a = b),
   162	        leftTensor (ι₂ := ZMod 2) (M.effect a)
   163	    exact (leftTensor_finset_sum _ _).symm
   164	  change (DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2)
   165	      (M.postprocess g)).postprocess u = _
   166	  rw [hplace, Measurement.postprocess_comp]
   167	  rfl

   169	/-- Placed measurements of the Pauli register with pairwise commuting effects
   170	have commuting effects. -/
   171	theorem placedPauliMeasurement_commute_of_commute {P : AdmissibleParams}
   172	    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   173	    (M : Measurement α (PauliRegister P)) (N : Measurement β (PauliRegister P))
   174	    (h : ∀ x y, Commute (M.effect x) (N.effect y))
   175	    (f : α → PauliAnswer P) (g : β → PauliAnswer P) (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   176	    Commute ((placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a)
   177	      ((placedPauliMeasurement N g).effect b) := by
   178	  rw [placedPauliMeasurement_effect_eq, placedPauliMeasurement_effect_eq]
   179	  refine leftPlaced_commute ?_
   180	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   181	  exact Commute.sum_left _ _ _ fun x _ => Commute.sum_right _ _ _ fun y _ => h x y

   183	/-- The deterministic measurement reports its prescribed outcome with the
   184	identity effect. -/
   185	theorem deterministicMeasurement_effect_self {α V : Type*}
   186	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (a₀ : α) :
   187	    (deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a₀).effect a₀ = 1 := by
   188	  change ((unitMeasurement V).postprocess (fun _ => a₀)).effect a₀ = 1
   189	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   190	  simp [unitMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne]
   191	
   192	/-- Every effect of a deterministic measurement commutes with every
   193	operator. -/
   194	theorem deterministicMeasurement_effect_commute {α V : Type*}
   195	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   196	    (a₀ a : α) (A : Op V) :
   197	    Commute ((deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a₀).effect a) A := by
   198	  by_cases h : a = a₀
   199	  · subst h
   200	    rw [deterministicMeasurement_effect_self]
   201	    exact Commute.one_left A
   202	  · rw [deterministicMeasurement_effect_eq_zero_of_ne h]
   203	    exact Commute.zero_left A

   207	/-- Every honest measurement at a question type reading a single Pauli basis is
   208	a relabelled coarse-graining of that basis measurement. -/
   209	theorem exists_placedBasis_of_basisType (P : AdmissibleParams) (t : PauliType)
   210	    (W : PauliKind) (z : PauliSpace P)
   211	    (ht : t = .point W ∨ t = .aline W ∨ t = .dline W ∨ t = .pauli W ∨
   212	      t = .pairW W) :
   213	    ∃ f : PauliRegister P → PauliAnswer P,
   214	      honestMeasurement P t z = placedPauliMeasurement (pauliBasisMeasurement W) f := by
   215	  rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
   216	  · exact ⟨_, placedPauliMeasurement_postprocess_eq (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   217	      (fun h => lowDegreeEnc h (pauliPointBlock W z)) (fun a => PauliAnswer.value a)⟩
   218	  · exact ⟨_, placedPauliMeasurement_postprocess_eq (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   219	      (fun h => restrictToAxisLine P.toLdParams
   220	        (aLineDescOf P.toLdParams (ldALineCL P.toLdParams (pauliToLd P W z)))
   221	        (lowDegreeEncoding h)) (fun a => PauliAnswer.alinePoly a)⟩
   222	  · exact ⟨_, placedPauliMeasurement_postprocess_eq (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   223	      (fun h => restrictToLine P.toLdParams
   224	        (dLineDescOf P.toLdParams (ldDLineCL P.toLdParams (pauliToLd P W z)))
   225	        (lowDegreeEncoding h)) (fun a => PauliAnswer.dlinePoly a)⟩
   226	  · exact ⟨fun a => PauliAnswer.pauliOutcome a, rfl⟩
   227	  · exact ⟨_, placedPauliMeasurement_postprocess_eq (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   228	      (pauliTraceBit P (pauliPointBlock W z)
   229	        (match W with | .X => pauliRXBlock z | .Z => pauliRZBlock z))
   230	      (fun a => PauliAnswer.bit a)⟩

   232	/-- Honest measurements reading one and the same Pauli basis have commuting
   233	effects, whatever the coefficient vectors carried by their questions. -/
   234	theorem honestMeasurement_basis_commute (P : AdmissibleParams) {t₁ t₂ : PauliType}
   235	    (W : PauliKind) (z₁ z₂ : PauliSpace P)
   236	    (h₁ : t₁ = .point W ∨ t₁ = .aline W ∨ t₁ = .dline W ∨ t₁ = .pauli W ∨
   237	      t₁ = .pairW W)
   238	    (h₂ : t₂ = .point W ∨ t₂ = .aline W ∨ t₂ = .dline W ∨ t₂ = .pauli W ∨
   239	      t₂ = .pairW W)
   240	    (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   241	    Commute ((honestMeasurement P t₁ z₁).effect a)
   242	      ((honestMeasurement P t₂ z₂).effect b) := by
   243	  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := exists_placedBasis_of_basisType P t₁ W z₁ h₁
   244	  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := exists_placedBasis_of_basisType P t₂ W z₂ h₂
   245	  rw [hf₁, hf₂]
   246	  exact placedPauliMeasurement_commute (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   247	    (fun h => pauliProj_isProj W h) f₁ f₂ a b

   249	/-! ### The Pair and Magic Square measurements -/
   250	
   251	/-- With a nonzero phase bit the honest measurements at the first and the fifth
   252	Magic Square variables are the honest Pair/X and Pair/Z measurements, hence
   253	relabelled coarse-grainings of the Pauli basis measurements. -/
   254	theorem honestMagicMeasurement_var_eq_placedBasis (P : AdmissibleParams)
   255	    (z : PauliSpace P) (hg : pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) :
   256	    honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 0) z =
   257	        placedPauliMeasurement (pauliBasisMeasurement .X)
   258	          (fun h => .bit (pauliTraceBit P (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z) h)) ∧
   259	      honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 4) z =
   260	        placedPauliMeasurement (pauliBasisMeasurement .Z)
   261	          (fun h => .bit (pauliTraceBit P (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z) h)) := by
   262	  classical
   263	  have hcell : ∀ (j : Fin 9) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   264	      (r : PauliScalar P),
   265	      (∀ b, (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg j).effect b =
   266	        heteroKron ((pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect b) (1 : Op (ZMod 2))) →
   267	      honestMagicMeasurement P (.var j) z =
   268	        placedPauliMeasurement (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   269	          (fun h => .bit (pauliTraceBit P u r h)) := by
   270	    intro j W u r hj
   271	    have hstep : honestMagicMeasurement P (.var j) z =
   272	        (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg j).postprocess
   273	          (fun b : ZMod 2 => (PauliAnswer.bit b : PauliAnswer P)) := by
   274	      have hunfold : honestMagicMeasurement P (.var j) z =
   275	          (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hg (.var j)).postprocess
   276	            (pauliAnswerOfMs (P := P)) := by
   277	        simp [honestMagicMeasurement, hg]
   278	      rw [hunfold, show pauliMagicMeasurement P z hg (.var j) =
   279	        (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg j).postprocess MsAnswer.bit from rfl,
   280	        Measurement.postprocess_comp]
   281	      rfl
   282	    have hplaced : DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2)
   283	        (pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r) = pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg j :=
   284	      Measurement.ext fun b => (hj b).symm
   285	    rw [hstep, ← hplaced]
   286	    exact placedPauliMeasurement_postprocess_eq (pauliBasisMeasurement W)
   287	      (pauliTraceBit P u r) (fun b => PauliAnswer.bit b)
   288	  have hA : ∀ b, (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg 0).effect b =
   289	      heteroKron
   290	        ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)).effect b)
   291	        (1 : Op (ZMod 2)) := by
   292	    intro b
   293	    rw [← msStrategyMeasurement_var_bit (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg)
   294	      (pauliMagicCellMeasurement_projective P z hg)
   295	      (pauliMagicCellMeasurement_commute P z hg) 0 b]
   296	    exact (pauliMagicMeasurement_var_effect P z hg b).1
   297	  have hB : ∀ b, (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg 4).effect b =
   298	      heteroKron
   299	        ((pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)).effect b)
   300	        (1 : Op (ZMod 2)) := by
   301	    intro b
   302	    rw [← msStrategyMeasurement_var_bit (pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hg)
   303	      (pauliMagicCellMeasurement_projective P z hg)
   304	      (pauliMagicCellMeasurement_commute P z hg) 4 b]
   305	    exact (pauliMagicMeasurement_var_effect P z hg b).2
   306	  exact ⟨hcell 0 .X (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z) hA,
   307	    hcell 4 .Z (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z) hB⟩

   309	/-- The honest Pair/W and Pair measurements have commuting effects. -/
   310	theorem honestPairW_pair_commute (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   311	    (z : PauliSpace P) (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   312	    Commute ((honestPairWMeasurement P W z).effect a)
   313	      ((honestPairMeasurement P z).effect b) := by
   314	  classical
   315	  by_cases hg : pauliPairGamma P z = 0
   316	  · have hpair : honestPairMeasurement P z =
   317	        placedPauliMeasurement (pauliPairMeasurement P z hg)
   318	          (fun c => PauliAnswer.pairBits c) := by
   319	      simp [honestPairMeasurement, hg]
   320	    rw [hpair]
   321	    refine placedPauliMeasurement_commute_of_commute _ _ ?_ _ _ a b
   322	    intro x c
   323	    cases W with
   324	    | X =>
   325	        exact Commute.mul_right
   326	          (postprocess_effect_commute (pauliBasisMeasurement .X)
   327	            (fun h => pauliProj_isProj .X h)
   328	            (pauliTraceBit P (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z))
   329	            (pauliTraceBit P (pauliXBlock z) (pauliRXBlock z)) x c.1)
   330	          (pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hg x c.2)
   331	    | Z =>
   332	        exact Commute.mul_right
   333	          ((pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hg c.1 x).symm)
   334	          (postprocess_effect_commute (pauliBasisMeasurement .Z)
   335	            (fun h => pauliProj_isProj .Z h)
   336	            (pauliTraceBit P (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z))
   337	            (pauliTraceBit P (pauliZBlock z) (pauliRZBlock z)) x c.2)
   338	  · have hpair : honestPairMeasurement P z =
   339	        deterministicMeasurement (V := HonestIndex P)
   340	          (PauliAnswer.pairBits (0, 0)) := by
   341	      simp [honestPairMeasurement, hg]
   342	    rw [hpair]
   343	    exact (deterministicMeasurement_effect_commute _ _ _).symm

   345	/-- The honest Magic Square measurements have commuting effects along every
   346	edge of the Magic Square type graph. -/
   347	theorem honestMagicMeasurement_ms_commute (P : AdmissibleParams)
   348	    (z : PauliSpace P) {s₁ s₂ : MsType} (hms : Sym2.mk s₁ s₂ ∈ msEdges)
   349	    (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   350	    Commute ((honestMagicMeasurement P s₁ z).effect a)
   351	      ((honestMagicMeasurement P s₂ z).effect b) := by
   352	  classical
   353	  by_cases hg : pauliPairGamma P z = 0
   354	  · cases s₁ with
   355	    | constraint i =>
   356	        have h₁ : honestMagicMeasurement P (.constraint i) z =
   357	            deterministicMeasurement (V := HonestIndex P)
   358	              (PauliAnswer.msTriple 0 : PauliAnswer P) := by
   359	          simp [honestMagicMeasurement, hg]
   360	        rw [h₁]
   361	        exact deterministicMeasurement_effect_commute _ _ _
   362	    | var j =>
   363	        have h₁ : honestMagicMeasurement P (.var j) z =
   364	            deterministicMeasurement (V := HonestIndex P)
   365	              (PauliAnswer.bit 0 : PauliAnswer P) := by
   366	          simp [honestMagicMeasurement, hg]
   367	        rw [h₁]
   368	        exact deterministicMeasurement_effect_commute _ _ _
   369	  · have h₁ : ∀ s : MsType, honestMagicMeasurement P s z =
   370	        (pauliMagicMeasurement P z hg s).postprocess (pauliAnswerOfMs (P := P)) := by
   371	      intro s
   372	      simp [honestMagicMeasurement, hg]
   373	    have hsupp : (s₁, s₂) ∈ msGameSymm.μ.support := by
   374	      change (s₁, s₂) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter
   375	        (fun ab => Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges)
   376	      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hms⟩
   377	    rcases msGame_support_incidence s₁ s₂ hsupp with
   378	      ⟨i, k, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, k, rfl, rfl⟩
   379	    · rw [h₁ _, h₁ _]
   380	      exact postprocess_commute_of_commute _ _
   381	        (fun x y => pauliMagicMeasurement_incident_commute P z hg i k x y) _ _ a b
   382	    · rw [h₁ _, h₁ _]
   383	      exact postprocess_commute_of_commute _ _
   384	        (fun x y => (pauliMagicMeasurement_incident_commute P z hg i k y x).symm)
   385	        _ _ a b

   387	/-! ### Commutation along the Pauli type graph -/
   388	
   389	/-- The honest measurements at the two ends of an ordered incidence form of the
   390	Pauli type graph have commuting effects. -/
   391	theorem honestMeasurement_commute_of_oriented (P : AdmissibleParams)
   392	    {t₁ t₂ : PauliType} (h : PauliEdgeOriented t₁ t₂) (z : PauliSpace P)
   393	    (a b : PauliAnswer P) :
   394	    Commute ((honestMeasurement P t₁ (pauliCL P t₁ z)).effect a)
   395	      ((honestMeasurement P t₂ (pauliCL P t₂ z)).effect b) := by
   396	  classical
   397	  rcases h with ⟨W, rfl, hW⟩ | ⟨W, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
   398	  · refine honestMeasurement_basis_commute P W _ _ (Or.inl rfl) ?_ a b
   399	    rcases hW with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
   400	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
   401	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
   402	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
   403	    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))
   404	  · exact honestPairW_pair_commute P W (pauliSharedProjection z) a b
   405	  · by_cases hg : pauliPairGamma P (pauliSharedProjection z) = 0
   406	    · have hdet : honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 0) (pauliSharedProjection z) =
   407	          deterministicMeasurement (V := HonestIndex P)
   408	            (PauliAnswer.bit 0) := by
   409	        simp [honestMagicMeasurement, hg]
   410	      change Commute ((honestMeasurement P (.point .X) _).effect a)
   411	        ((honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 0) (pauliSharedProjection z)).effect b)
   412	      rw [hdet]
   413	      exact (deterministicMeasurement_effect_commute _ _ _).symm
   414	    · obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := exists_placedBasis_of_basisType P (.point .X) .X
   415	        (pauliCL P (.point .X) z) (Or.inl rfl)
   416	      have h₂ : honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 0) (pauliSharedProjection z) =
   417	          placedPauliMeasurement (pauliBasisMeasurement .X)
   418	            (fun h => .bit (pauliTraceBit P
   419	              (pauliXBlock (pauliSharedProjection z))
   420	              (pauliRXBlock (pauliSharedProjection z)) h)) :=
   421	        (honestMagicMeasurement_var_eq_placedBasis P (pauliSharedProjection z) hg).1
   422	      change Commute ((honestMeasurement P (.point .X) _).effect a)
   423	        ((honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 0) (pauliSharedProjection z)).effect b)
   424	      rw [hf₁, h₂]
   425	      exact placedPauliMeasurement_commute (pauliBasisMeasurement .X)
   426	        (fun h => pauliProj_isProj .X h) f₁ _ a b
   427	  · by_cases hg : pauliPairGamma P (pauliSharedProjection z) = 0
   428	    · have hdet : honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 4) (pauliSharedProjection z) =
   429	          deterministicMeasurement (V := HonestIndex P)
   430	            (PauliAnswer.bit 0) := by
   431	        simp [honestMagicMeasurement, hg]
   432	      change Commute ((honestMeasurement P (.point .Z) _).effect a)
   433	        ((honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 4) (pauliSharedProjection z)).effect b)
   434	      rw [hdet]
   435	      exact (deterministicMeasurement_effect_commute _ _ _).symm
   436	    · obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := exists_placedBasis_of_basisType P (.point .Z) .Z
   437	        (pauliCL P (.point .Z) z) (Or.inl rfl)
   438	      have h₂ : honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 4) (pauliSharedProjection z) =
   439	          placedPauliMeasurement (pauliBasisMeasurement .Z)
   440	            (fun h => .bit (pauliTraceBit P
   441	              (pauliZBlock (pauliSharedProjection z))
   442	              (pauliRZBlock (pauliSharedProjection z)) h)) :=
   443	        (honestMagicMeasurement_var_eq_placedBasis P (pauliSharedProjection z) hg).2
   444	      change Commute ((honestMeasurement P (.point .Z) _).effect a)
   445	        ((honestMagicMeasurement P (.var 4) (pauliSharedProjection z)).effect b)
   446	      rw [hf₁, h₂]
   447	      exact placedPauliMeasurement_commute (pauliBasisMeasurement .Z)
   448	        (fun h => pauliProj_isProj .Z h) f₁ _ a b
   449	
   450	/-- The honest measurement family has commuting effects on every question pair
   451	of positive weight for the Pauli question sampler.  This is the commutation
   452	obligation of the honest strategy in `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
   453	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1382`. -/
   454	theorem honestMeasurement_commuting (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   455	    IsCommutingOn (pauliQuestionDistribution P)
   456	      (fun q : PauliQuestion P => honestMeasurement P q.1 q.2)
   457	      (fun q : PauliQuestion P => honestMeasurement P q.1 q.2) := by
   458	  intro x y hxy a b
   459	  obtain ⟨z, hedge, hx, hy⟩ := pauliQuestionDistribution_pos_incidence P x y hxy
   460	  change Commute ((honestMeasurement P x.1 x.2).effect a)
   461	    ((honestMeasurement P y.1 y.2).effect b)
   462	  rw [hx, hy]
   463	  rcases pauliEdges_cases hedge with heq | ⟨s₁, s₂, hs₁, hs₂, hms⟩ | hor | hor
   464	  · rw [heq]
   465	    exact honestMeasurement_self_commute P y.1 _ a b
   466	  · rw [hs₁, hs₂]
   467	    exact honestMagicMeasurement_ms_commute P (pauliSharedProjection z) hms a b
   468	  · exact honestMeasurement_commute_of_oriented P hor z a b
   469	  · exact (honestMeasurement_commute_of_oriented P hor z b a).symm
   470
